description: Retrieve all records in a list with pagination (companies, people in pipelines). Never filter entries or modify list memberships. Requires list UUID (not slug); default limit 20, max per page varies by API. Use filter-list-entries for attribute-based filtering instead.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to fetch (default: 20)

listId.description: UUID of the list to get entries for

offset.description: Number of entries to skip for pagination (default: 0)

name: get-list-entries
